what_happened: The job to make later_similar_task match on class of work, not on any later landed job, was rejected at the final verdict. One of 8 acceptance criteria was unmet: the one requiring cargo fmt --check, clippy and cargo test to pass. The test check failed in shard 3 of 6, where one unit, athena-cli --test drain, failed. The kept output shows only compile lines and a passing doc-test, so the failing assertion is not visible. The verifier also gave one major finding: behavior criterion 8 is unmet because its evidence must cite commands that ran (D43).
cause: Nothing made the producer find and run the existing tests that exercise the code it changed before it finished. Changing the matching rule in later_similar_task alters what the status output and related flows report. The drain integration test in athena-cli, outside the edited crate, was affected, and it was reached only by the full sharded test check at the final verdict. The behavior-evidence rule (D43) was again not tied to commands the producer actually ran. The same job family fails the same way again.
other_causes: The kept test output is CI noise (compile lines and a passing doc-test), so the producer and verifier cannot see the failing drain assertion.
Behavior criterion 8 needed evidence of commands that ran, and the producer's report did not supply it.
open_hypotheses: The drain test may fail because fixtures there have no class-of-work data, so the new class match finds no later similar task. The fields do not show this.
The drain test failure may be flaky or already present on main. No baseline is given.
The status-output line that the new matching feeds may be what the drain test reads. The fields do not confirm it.
contradictions: The fix is a narrowing of a predicate in a records module, which does not obviously touch drain behavior. The failing unit is athena-cli --test drain, so the link between the change and the failure is unconfirmed.
prevention: Before finishing, the producer should be required to run the tests that read the output or behavior it changes, and then the full test suite, in the same shard layout CI uses. It should cite the commands it ran as evidence for the behavior criteria. The plan should name the existing tests that read the changed output. A failed-check record should keep the failing test name and assertion instead of CI cleanup lines. Every gate in gate_counts shows 0 disagreements, so relaxing or removing a gate is not supported.
proposed_request: Match later_similar_task in crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs on class of work: a later landed job counts as a similar task only if its class of work equals the accepted job's class of work. Before finishing, find every existing test that reads the output of this function or of athena status, including athena-cli --test drain, and run it. Then run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test. If any test fails, fix the cause, and report each command you ran with its result. Add a records test with two landed jobs, one of the same class and one of a different class after the fix. The test must show that only the same-class job counts as a later similar task. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.
